_doc: L1 (2026-11-05) ElevenLabs SFX cue sheet. One entry per Sfx.NAMES cue. g = generation length (s, the node's duration_seconds), pi = prompt influence, p = prompt variants (4 takes each), tier = mastering tier (tools/sfx_master.py), len = final length window (s), align = riser crest time (s) for build-ups. design/audio/sfx-design-2026-11-05.md is the readable table.

cues.name: ui_hover
cues.ctx: Pointer enters a button or menu item (rate-limited, jittered).
p: Extremely soft tiny brush of a fingertip across thick parchment, faint airy whisper, very quiet, close-mic, dry
Very faint delicate tick of a small wooden bead, muted and soft, extremely short, close-mic, dry
Single tiny soft tap of a fingertip on a wooden table, very short, muted and quiet, close-mic, dry
Very soft short brush of a fingertip across a playing card, one tiny papery tick, close-mic, dry

cues.name: card_hover
cues.ctx: Pointer enters a card (hand, draft, rewards, catalogue).
p: Soft short slide of a single playing card lifted off a felt table, gentle papery swish, quiet, close-mic, dry
One thick playing card sliding a few centimetres across green felt, very soft and short, close-mic

cues.name: select
cues.ctx: Generic selection: a card, a chat open, an inspect, a list row.
p: Single small crisp wooden tick, a game token tapped once on an oak table, light and clean, close-mic, dry
Tiny bright clean tick of a small brass pin, single short click, close-mic, dry

cues.name: click_primary
cues.ctx: Gold (primary) button or menu item press.
p: Single crisp click of a small brass button on a wooden box, short bright metallic tick with a soft wooden knock, close-mic, dry
Short satisfying click of an ornate gold latch, crisp metallic snap with a tiny resonant ring, close-mic, dry

cues.name: click_secondary
p: Soft muted click of a leather-covered wooden button, dull warm knock, short and dry, close-mic
Short soft knock of a knuckle on a leather-bound wooden box, warm and muted, single hit, close-mic

cues.name: back
cues.ctx: Back / Close / Cancel / Leave buttons and Esc.
p: Leather book cover closing softly, short muted thump with a light paper swish, close-mic, dry
Two quick soft wooden knocks stepping down in pitch, muted and short, close-mic, dry

cues.name: confirm
cues.ctx: Confirming a choice (end turn, prompt OK, selection done).
p: Bright positive confirmation chime, two ascending notes on a small brass bell struck with a soft mallet, warm, fantasy
Gentle magical confirmation, a clean rising glass and brass chime with a tiny sparkle, short

cues.name: cancel
cues.ctx: Backing out of a selection or targeting.
p: Soft descending two-note chime on a muted wooden marimba, gentle and short
Soft short downward swish of parchment pulled away, ending in a muted wooden tap

cues.name: deny
cues.ctx: Illegal action (no AP, invalid target, deck limit).
p: Dull short rattle of a locked iron padlock being tugged once, muted negative thud, close-mic
Low muted wooden double knock, firm and short negative feedback, dull and dry

cues.name: tab
p: Soft leather flap flipping over, short muted thump, close-mic, dry
Quick soft turn of a single thick parchment page, short, close-mic
Single quick soft flap of a thick leather book page turning over, short papery thump, close-mic, dry
Short soft slap of a leather tab folding over, muted mid-range thud, single hit, close-mic, dry

cues.name: toggle_on
p: Small brass latch clicking shut, two tiny crisp clicks rising in pitch, short, close-mic, dry

cues.name: toggle_off
p: Small brass latch clicking open, two tiny soft clicks falling in pitch, short, close-mic, dry

cues.name: slider_tick
p: Tiny soft click of a wooden rosary bead sliding against another, very short and quiet, close-mic, dry
Single tiny soft click of a small wooden bead, very short, one click only, close-mic, dry
One tiny muted tick of a small brass ratchet, very short, single click, close-mic, dry

cues.name: panel_open
p: Parchment scroll unrolling quickly with a soft papery swish and a faint magical shimmer, short
Heavy leather book cover opening, soft creak and quick paper flutter, short

cues.name: panel_close
p: Parchment scroll rolling up quickly, soft papery swish ending in a light tap, short
Old book closing gently, soft leather thump with a puff of air, short

cues.name: customise_select
cues.ctx: Picking a cosmetic / table / card back option (L28).
p: Glass bead dropping into a velvet-lined wooden tray with a tiny bright sparkle, soft and satisfying, short
Soft warm wooden token set into a velvet-lined tray with a gentle low chime, short and satisfying

cues.name: deck_add
cues.ctx: Card added to a deck in the deck builder.
p: Playing card slid quickly into a wooden deck box, upward paper slide ending in a soft tap, close-mic
Single card tucked into a stack of cards, quick papery slide and soft tick, close-mic

cues.name: deck_remove
p: Playing card pulled out of a tight stack of cards, quick downward papery slide, close-mic
Card drawn out of a wooden deck box, short soft scrape of paper ending in a muted thud
Single playing card quickly flicked off a stack, short sharp papery snap, close-mic, dry

cues.name: chat
cues.ctx: Chat message while the chat box is closed.
p: Two soft bright glass bell tings rising, gentle and quiet message notification

cues.name: chat_pop
cues.ctx: New chat message preview bubble pops out.
p: Soft round water bubble pop followed by a tiny bright bell ting, friendly and light
Small soft magical pop with a bright little two-note glass chime

cues.name: step_done
p: Small bright magical chime, a short rising sparkle, gentle achievement ding

cues.name: zone_pick
cues.ctx: Choosing a board zone (where to place a card).
p: Soft wooden game token placed onto a board square, short muted clack with a faint magical shimmer, close-mic

cues.name: card_draw
cues.ctx: Each card drawn (also pile browser deal, deck select).
p: Playing card drawn quickly from the top of a deck, crisp papery swipe, close-mic, dry
Single thick playing card slid off a deck with a quick paper snap and a faint magical sparkle

cues.name: card_play
cues.ctx: A card is played face up to a zone.
p: Playing card placed firmly face up on a wooden table, crisp paper snap and soft wooden tap, close-mic
Thick card snapped down onto an oak table with a light magical shimmer, short and crisp

cues.name: card_set
cues.ctx: A card is set face down (backrow). Same for every card: hides identity.
p: Playing card placed face down on a felt table, soft muted papery thud, gentle, close-mic
Card laid face down quietly on cloth, soft slide and muffled tap, close-mic

cues.name: card_slam
cues.ctx: Set-piece summon: the card lands on the table.
p: Thick playing card slammed down hard on a heavy oak table, deep punchy wooden thump with a puff of dust
Heavy card slapped onto a wooden table, deep resonant thud and dusty impact

cues.name: card_discard
cues.ctx: Card discarded to the Spent pile.
p: Playing card tossed onto a pile of cards, light papery flick and slide, close-mic
Card flicked away onto a stack, quick paper whip and soft landing

cues.name: card_return
p: Playing card swept back up from a table into a hand of cards, quick reverse papery swish, close-mic

cues.name: card_shuffle
p: Deck of playing cards riffle shuffled and bridged, crisp and quick, close-mic
Quick riffle shuffle of a deck of cards on a wooden table, crisp paper flutter

cues.name: card_flip
cues.ctx: Face-down card revealed (identical for every card).
p: Playing card flipped over on a table, quick crisp paper flip with a soft snap and a faint magical shimmer

cues.name: stance_attack
p: Sword drawn quickly from a leather scabbard, short metallic ring, ready for battle
Short steel blade unsheathed with a bright ringing scrape

cues.name: stance_defense
p: Heavy wooden shield raised and braced, solid thump of leather and wood with a soft metal clank
Iron-rimmed shield set firmly down, deep wooden knock with a short metallic rattle

cues.name: attack
p: Fast sword swing whoosh, sharp swish of a blade through the air, fantasy combat
Quick heavy blade swipe whoosh with a faint magical trail

cues.name: impact
cues.ctx: Attack lands on a unit; killing-blow hits; coin landing.
p: Sword striking a wooden shield, punchy heavy thud with a metallic edge
Heavy weapon hit on armour, punchy crunchy impact, fantasy combat

cues.name: damage
p: Heavy blunt hit, deep punchy thump with a crunch and a low rumble, fantasy combat damage, no voice
Deep magical blow landing, punchy low thud with crackling energy, no voice
Heavy punch impact with a crunchy crack and a solid mid-range thud, fantasy combat hit, no voice
Magical blast striking armour, sharp crack and crunchy impact with a short rumble, no voice

cues.name: block
p: Sword striking a raised iron shield, loud metallic clang with a heavy thud, ringing briefly
Blade blocked by a steel shield, sharp clang and solid thump

cues.name: miss
p: Sword whooshing through empty air, fast light swish that misses
Quick dodge, a nimble cloth whoosh and a blade swishing past

cues.name: destroy
p: Stone and wood figurine shattering into pieces, crunchy break with crumbling debris, fantasy
Magical creature shattering, crackling burst of crystal shards and crumbling stone

cues.name: exhaust
p: Dark magical void suction, a whoosh pulled downward into nothing ending in a dull hollow thud
Card dissolving into a void, reversed airy swell and deep hollow pull fading away

cues.name: sacrifice
p: Soft fire whoosh consuming a paper card, crackling flames and rising embers, dark ritual
Card burning away in a magical flame, quick ignition whoosh and fading crackle

cues.name: boom
p: Huge deep explosion of magical energy, massive sub boom with a crack and long rumbling tail
Massive fantasy magic blast, deep thunderous boom with debris and long rumble
Massive magical explosion with a sharp crack, crackling debris and a deep boom fading into a long rumble

cues.name: charge
cues.ctx: Killing-blow wind-up (slow motion), crests into the boom.
p: Rising magical energy swell building tension, whooshing riser growing louder and higher, stopping at its peak
Ominous powerful energy charging up, rising roar and shimmer accelerating to a peak

cues.name: heal
p: Gentle holy healing magic, warm shimmering chimes rising with a soft glowing hum, fantasy
Soothing healing spell, soft rising harp-like sparkle and warm magical glow

cues.name: buff
p: Magical power-up, bright rising shimmer with a warm brass resonance, short fantasy buff spell

cues.name: debuff
p: Dark magical hex, a descending warped tone with a sinister whoosh, short fantasy debuff spell

cues.name: ap_gain
p: Bright two-note amber crystal twinkle, small magical gem lighting up, short and clean
Warm mid-pitched two-note glass chime, a small amber gem lighting up, soft and pleasant, short

cues.name: ap_loss
p: Dull short descending glass blip, a small crystal gem dimming, soft and short

cues.name: hp_low_heartbeat
cues.ctx: Low HP: one heartbeat every 2.2 s on the local turn.
p: Single slow deep heartbeat, lub-dub, warm muffled low thump, felt more than heard, no music

cues.name: status_rune
p: Ancient rune glyph glowing to life, a deep resonant stone hum with a bright mystical chime

cues.name: status_retain
cues.ctx: Retain (not discarded at end of turn).
p: Magical binding seal locking in place, soft chain rattle and a warm golden chime
Warm golden magical seal locking in place, a soft metallic latch click and a gentle low resonant chime

cues.name: status_reveal
p: Mystical eye opening, airy shimmering whoosh revealing something hidden, with a bright sparkle

cues.name: status_eternal
p: Holy divine protection aura, radiant shimmering glass harmonics and a bright crystal bell, heavenly, no voice

cues.name: status_burn
p: Burst of fire igniting, quick whoosh into crackling flames

cues.name: status_pierce
p: Steel spear tip piercing through armour, sharp metallic scrape and stab with a bright ring

cues.name: status_cleanse
p: Purifying water magic, a clear gentle splash with sparkling cleansing chimes

cues.name: status_paralyse
cues.ctx: Paralyse (cannot attack, move or change stance).
p: Crackling electric shock zap, sharp static lightning buzz that freezes in place

cues.name: status_medic
p: Soft holy healing aura, a warm gentle bell and a soothing shimmering hum

cues.name: status_curse
p: Ominous dark curse, a low sinister rumble with hollow ghostly wind and a dissonant tone, no voice
Dark curse spell, a sinister descending dissonant chime with a hollow ghostly whoosh, eerie, no voice

cues.name: status_poison
p: Thick green poison bubbling and squelching, wet gurgling bubbles with a sickly hiss

cues.name: status_infiltrate
p: Sneaky shadow magic, a quick dark whoosh slipping past, stealthy and soft

cues.name: status_blind
p: Dark smoke cloud puffing out and enveloping, muffled whoosh with a fading dull tone
Thick magical smoke bursting out in a soft puff, muffled hissing whoosh fading away, mid-range

cues.name: status_nimble
p: Light quick wind flutter, nimble airy swish like a feather darting past, with a tiny chime
Quick light double whoosh of a nimble dodge, airy cloth swish with a tiny bright chime

cues.name: status_debilitate
p: Magic draining away, a weakening downward wilting tone with a soft deflating whoosh

cues.name: status_blocked
cues.ctx: Cleanse / Curse stack stops an application.
p: Magical barrier deflecting a spell, a glassy shield ping with a dull bounce

cues.name: status_expire
p: Magical aura fading away, a soft dissolving shimmer descending into silence

cues.name: burn_tick
p: Short burst of flame crackle, a quick fiery sizzle

cues.name: poison_tick
p: Short wet sickly poison bubble pop with a small hiss

cues.name: summon
p: Fantasy creature summoned onto a battlefield, a magical whoosh and shimmering burst landing with a deep thud
Magical summoning, a short rising shimmer that lands with a deep warm impact and sparkling dust

cues.name: fusion_vortex
cues.ctx: Fusion build-up; crests at the climax (0.78 s).
p: Swirling magical vortex building up, two energies spiralling together, rising whooshing riser growing louder
Powerful brass-like drone and swirling wind rising and accelerating into a peak, magical fusion building

cues.name: fusion_impact
p: Two magical forces fusing in a powerful bright burst, deep warm boom blooming into a shimmering resonant brass chord, epic fantasy
Epic fantasy fusion explosion, deep soft boom and a glorious ringing magical chord with sparkles, long reverb tail

cues.name: ritual_choir
cues.ctx: Ritual build-up; crests at the climax (0.88 s).
p: Dark sacred ritual building up, low ominous drone with deep ritual drums quickening, rising tension
Ominous dark ritual swell, deep rumbling drone and heartbeat drums rising to a peak
Dark ritual building up, deep frame drums quickening under an ominous rising bowed string drone, tension swelling to a peak
Ominous low brass and timpani crescendo rising quickly to a peak, dark ceremony

cues.name: ritual_impact
p: Huge temple gong struck in a dark stone hall, deep ominous resonant boom with a long dark tail
Dark ritual completion, a massive deep gong and drum hit with an ominous swelling drone and long reverb

cues.name: arcane_shimmer
cues.ctx: Arcane build-up; crests at the climax (0.82 s).
p: Crystalline magical shimmer building up, glassy sparkling grains rising in pitch and swelling
Rising glass harmonica shimmer with sparkling crystal particles accelerating to a peak

cues.name: arcane_impact
cues.ctx: Arcane climax: mystical bloom, not a hit (owner H28).
p: Mystical arcane spell resolving into light, a soft blooming glass harmonica chord with sparkling shimmer and airy reverb, no hard hit
Ethereal magical bloom, shimmering crystal chord swelling softly with twinkling sparkles and a long airy tail

cues.name: fuse
p: Two magical energies merging, rising shimmer converging into a bright ringing strike

cues.name: ritual
p: Low pulsing dark ritual drone ending with a deep drum strike

cues.name: arcane
p: Glassy ascending magical chime arpeggio, sparkling and bright

cues.name: spell_cast
cues.ctx: Spell spotlight: the card lands centre-screen (HOLD 1.85 s).
p: Fantasy spell being cast, a rising glassy whoosh releasing into a bright magical shimmer with airy reverb
Magic spell cast, a quick sparkling swoosh blooming into a radiant chime and glittering tail

cues.name: trap_spring
cues.ctx: Trap spotlight: a trap springs (darker than the Spell).
p: Hidden trap springing, sharp wooden latch snap and iron jaws clanging shut with a dark ominous resonance
Mechanical trap triggered, quick metal snap and heavy clank followed by a dark low brass sting

cues.name: serpent_coil
p: Giant serpent rising and coiling, long menacing hiss with scales sliding and a watery swirl

cues.name: serpent_strike
p: Giant water serpent striking, fast whoosh followed by a heavy watery splash crash and deep thud

cues.name: evolve_charge
p: Creature transformation energy building, organic magical crackling and a rising shimmering hum swelling to a peak

cues.name: evolve_burst
p: Magical transformation burst, a bright explosive shimmering whoosh with a deep resonant bloom, creature evolving
Powerful metamorphosis, a deep magical boom opening into a rising radiant shimmer and sparkling tail

cues.name: copy_form
cues.ctx: Shapeshifter Loak / Mimic copies a Unit's form (L11).
p: Shapeshifting magic, a wobbling liquid morph whoosh with a shimmering mirror-like tone

cues.name: control_steal
p: Hypnotic mind control spell, a warbling dark swirling tone pulling inward

cues.name: control_return
p: Mind control spell breaking, a swirling tone unwinding with a release whoosh and a soft chime

cues.name: turn
p: Deep resonant bronze bell struck once, warm long ring, fantasy
Soft heavy gong-like bronze bell, single warm strike with a gentle ringing tail

cues.name: phase
p: Soft airy magical whoosh with a gentle two-tone chime

cues.name: notice
cues.ctx: Generic notice (prompt shown, coin result, tutorial).
p: Single clear bright bell ding, gentle attention chime, short ring

cues.name: prompt_alert
p: Two quick bright crystal bell notes, pleasant attention alert

cues.name: opponent_responding
p: Soft mysterious low magical hum with a faint shimmering pulse, waiting

cues.name: hourglass_flip

cues.name: timer_tick

cues.name: timer_warning

cues.name: game_start
cues.ctx: A game begins (after the shuffle / coin flip).

Short epic fantasy horn call with a deep drum hit, start of a battle

cues.ctx: First-player coin flip (spin 1.7 s, then landing).

cues.name: victory

Bright victorious fantasy fanfare with horns and bells, short and joyful

Epic medieval victory fanfare with trumpets, choir-like strings and drums, celebratory finale, no voice

cues.name: defeat

cues.name: series_point

cues.name: reward_reveal

cues.name: reward_pick

cues.name: draft_reveal
p: Several playing cards fanned out quickly on a table with a magical shimmer, quick paper spread and sparkle

cues.name: draft_pick

cues.name: sacrifice_mode_on
p: Dark ritual flame igniting, low ominous whoosh with a soft ember crackle, short

cues.name: sacrifice_mode_off

p: Bow string drawn back slowly, tense creak of wood, aiming
